newsitem.title: THAILAND: Eastern Water says share IPO oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Water says share IPO oversubscribed.

text.p: Thai utility firm Eastern Water Resources Development and Management Plc said on Tuesday its initial public share offer has been oversubscribed by foreign and local investors.
Eastern Water said in a statement its 50-million-share IPO, at 30 baht a share, has been oversubscribed 13 and six times respectively by international and local investors.
Eastern Water conducted an international roadshow for its IPO in Singapore, Hong Kong and London during June 5-12.

Thai Investment and Securities Plc and Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc are lead underwriters for the domestic portion while ABN AMRO Rothschild handles the offshore offer, which is open on June 18-20, it said.
Eastern Water said it expects the stock to be listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand in July.

Eastern Water, operator of water service utility for factories in eastern Thailand, is majority owned by state-owned Metropolitan Electricity Authority and the Industrial Estate Authority of Thailand.
